R&B Forever Tour featuring Ashanti, Tyrese, Tank, Ginuwine, Silk & Lloyd* comes to Brooklyn on Saturday, April 26.

R&B Forever Tour was originally scheduled on Saturday, November 9, 2024. Any tickets held for the show on November 9, 2024 will automatically be valid for the rescheduled date on April 26, 2025. No additional action by ticket holders is required.

*Lineup subject to change without notice.
